objective: Prove the knot facts under the forgetting reading the owner chose on 2026-10-19. Erasing a loop forgets it, so a knot is a relation over the loops' open distinctions and a contact that is constrained as a whole and unconstrained in every part. Establish: the census of two-loop knots (34 patterns in five shapes, from the atom to parity); that no 2-CNF with witnesses defines a knot; that a knot implies no clause narrower than its variables; that naming partial matches keeps parity at three literals; and that every knot of the absence reading is a knot here. Check the two-loop theorems in Lean.
status: Proved by KNOT-FOUNDATION-20261019-001E-P001: under the forgetting reading a knot is constrained as a whole and unconstrained in every part; 34 two-loop knots in five shapes from the atom to parity; no 2-CNF with witnesses defines one; Lean 4.32.2 kernel and an independent checker.
title: The forgetting reading: the canonical knot test from 2026-10-19
